'''Vantsuri Shia''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Shia led the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] infiltration team that took up residence in the newly abandoned [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under orders of [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]]. Shia commadeered her team from the [[Grand Master's offices|former quarters]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
